standard_prerequisites.name: On affines the derived pullback agrees with derived tensor with the ring map on module complexes, up to the K-flat replacement construction
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the commutativity of the square of functors.

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the derived category of quasi-coherent modules is equivalent to the derived category of modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Translates E into a complex of A-modules and identifies the pullback.

core_obligations: First prove the commutativity of the square D(A) -> D(O_X) -> D(O_Y) against D(A) -> D(B) -> D(O_Y): this is clear from the affine K-flat lemma and the constructions of the functors (proof lines 600-607).

Part (1): quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves of Lf^*E is local on X, and Lf^* is compatible with restriction to opens, so it suffices to treat a morphism of affine schemes as in (2) (proof lines 608-612).

Conclude: by the affine comparison E comes from a complex of A-modules; by the commutativity of the first square Lf^*E comes from a complex of B-modules, hence has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, proving (1); part (2) is the commutativity already established (proof lines 613-616).
proof_roadmap: Establish the module-level commutative square on affines (proof lines 600-607).
Localize the quasi-coherence assertion to affine morphisms (proof lines 608-612).
Conclude via the affine comparison (proof lines 613-616).
